skills.name: Yuuuuuuuuuuuuum!
skills.description: Eats his sister's cooking. Gushes it back out while smiling and crying. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Resistance +20% (8 sec) *Area Magical DEF +20000 (8 sec) *Recovers 50% of HP

skills.name: Protect My Sister's Country
skills.description: Puts on his gloves and beats enemies up, ending with a kick. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Move Speed -30% (10 sec) *Enemy ATK Speed -30% (10 sec) *ATK x 2200% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: SPYxFAMILY
abilities.description: SPYxFAMILY Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
